result.reason: The language appears to reach the fallback position: it provides a facially mutual 12-month-fees cap, mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and uncapped confidentiality, gross-negligence and willful-misconduct liabilities; the Section 8 exception must be the indemnification carve-out for full fallback compliance. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks the USD 1 million floor and express data-protection, security and fraud carve-outs, and its IP carve-out is narrower than all infringement. The redline is not minimal and changes unrelated economics by adding a three-times-annual-fees support cap and customer-credit pass-through. It also uncaps all payment obligations rather than clarifying only that Customer payment obligations are not damages. Undefined “annual fees,” the ambiguous Section 8 cross-reference, and the duplicated/corrupted trailing text reduce drafting quality.
